issue_request: FHIR-40519 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested clearer FHIR-core messaging wording: the base spec provides a direct delivery mechanism, other transfer mechanisms can be abstracted, and those mechanisms should define exact message transfer protocols in implementation guides.
initial_application: The requested wording was applied to source/messaging.html by merge commit 87b1af3c094d4dd726733409d815683ceeab15c7 on 2023-02-24. The issue key also appears in topic-branch commit 5e04fe1f02dae32f3f0abc945c15dade0d13a5cd, but the paragraph rewrite itself is in the merge commit.
additional_context: The February 2023 Zulip discussion and FHIR-I Confluence minutes show the protocol wording came from the same messaging response discussion as FHIR-40518. Later Published/Persuasive FHIR-40501 added Apache Kafka to the same transfer mechanism example list, explaining the current source's extra example compared with the exact FHIR-40519 replacement text.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/messaging.html:74-84 already says the spec provides a direct delivery mechanism, transfer can be abstracted, alternate transfer mechanisms are expected to define implementation guides, and logical-to-implementation address mapping is outside FHIR's scope.
